events.title: 리버풀 signed defender Steve Finnan from 풀럼 for £3.6 million.
데이비드 베컴 completed his £25 million move from 맨체스터 유나이티드 to 레알 마드리드 .
버밍엄 시티 paid a club record £5.5 million for 블랙번 로버스 midfielder David Dunn .
리버풀 signed 리즈 유나이티드's Harry Kewell for £5 million.
맨체스터 유나이티드 signed American goalkeeper 팀 하워드 from MetroStars for £2.3 million; 첼시 paid £6 million for 19-year-old 웨스트햄 유나이티드 defender 글렌 존슨 .
첼시 signed Cameroon midfielder Geremi from 레알 마드리드 for £7 million.
첼시 signed 사우샘프턴 defender 웨인 브리지 for £7 million and 블랙번 로버스 winger 데이미언 더프 for a club record £17 million.
The Premier League was officially declared the richest football league in Europe.
